activity_summary: Master Thwaite reached fourteenthly, and you lost the head he was on. You told him you had come because it was Sunday. Mistress Ansell told you to sit, and that Sir John was not your text. Sir John stayed in his pew and did not turn, and he did not speak. You brought no sentence home.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Lost the head of the sermon, and said he had come because it was Sunday.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Told him to sit, and kept Sir John off his text.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Said fourteenthly, and would not write the sermon out.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat in his pew. He did not turn, and he did not speak.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have lost the head he is on.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Sir John is in his pew. He is not your text, and he is not looking.
